title: 第三百四十八章 半年之约第三百四十七章 滴血认亲
lines: 第两百四十八章：半年之约
确定了朱易的身份，他自然要接过左国正的爵位，左国正的官职。等刘戈确认了朱易的身份，开始给朱易办理归籍的各种档案、公文，交接各种印玺和令牌的时候，严回就臭着一张脸扬长而去。
忙碌了一个晚上，终于忙完了所有的交接手续，朱易摇身一变，就变成了大汉朝的宗室，大汉朝公爵左国正，左国正。在刘戈殷勤的带领下，朱易带来的所有门客都入驻了刘琦留下的左国正府。那可是一栋在长安排名前三十位，占地千亩，极其豪奢的大宅子。
等朱易把当下最紧要的几个问题理顺，将左国正府的那些大小主管都聚集在一起时，已经是正午时分。昨夜的狂风暴雨好像一场噩梦一样，没有留下半点儿痕迹，如今正是烈阳高照，炽热的阳光晒得站在公爵府大院里的数百大小管事油汗直淌。
披着一件纱衣，朱易坐在屋檐下，冷眼看着这些面色恭谨的大小管事。
等太阳晒得这些管事都快昏厥过去了，朱易才轻描淡写的说道：“罢了，以后安心做事，用心做事。一切都按照以前的规矩来。我不是那种不近人情的主子，只要你们勤勤勉勉恭恭敬敬的，不会一定要挑几个倒霉鬼出来杀给其他人看。”。
叶重斜靠在一根柱子上，笑呵呵的看着这些管事。朱易放任他们被太阳晒成这样，也是应有之意。新主子上台，不给这些下面人一点苦头吃吃，说不定还会有多少乱七八糟的事情出来。
多少敲打一下，也方便朱易以后真正接管刘琦留下的这笔巨额遗产。不说左国正这个官职有多大的权力，就说刘琦名下两郡之地的封地，一年的产出是多少？两郡之中有多少产业是朱易的？这都要多少人去打理？
就看这公爵府上管事的人都有四百多人，就可想而知这是一份多大的家业了。随即只听见环佩声响，梅青竹带着几个贴身侍女，背后跟着那条凶恶的血芒子，满脸是笑的走了过来。
“朱易我儿，你初来长安，一切都不熟悉。这公爵府上的大小事务，手上也没有合用的人选，娘亲这里倒是有不少精明能干的人，也能帮你分担分担！”，梅青竹笑得眼睛都眯成了一条线，朱易成了大汉公爵，这能给她的母族带来多大的好处？
叶重笑了，他看着朱易，看他怎么答这句话。
让梅青竹带来的那些管事先生，插手左国正府的事情，怕是过一段时间后，就没朱易什么事了吧？相反而言，左国正府的这些管事，虽然朱易不熟悉他们，但是毕竟是刘琦这家子的世代家仆，反而更加可靠，更加值得信赖。
朱易面沉如水的看着梅青竹，过了许久，才低低的叹了一口气。
“这些俗务，就不劳娘亲操心了。刘福，给夫人准备价值三百万金的财物，送夫人出府。夫人带来的那些人手，每人都打发一点金银，怎么说也是来了长安一趟，不能让他们白跑！”
院子里众多管事中，站在最前面的四个老人中带头的那个白须老人急忙上前一步，毕恭毕敬的应了一声。
梅青竹的一张脸当即变成了铁青色，她怨毒的瞪着朱易，厉声叫道：“朱易，你！”。
朱易淡淡的看着梅青竹，随即却是轻声说道：“不管怎么样，你毕竟是孩儿娘亲。所以，孩儿会保定远侯一家富贵。定远侯府想要做什么，随时派人来和我联系就是。但是，朱家和孩儿没有半分关系！”。
梅青竹双眼一转，铁青的脸上突然露出了艳若春花的笑容道：“你这孩子，怎么这么吓唬娘亲呢？不和朱家有关？娘亲明白了。要不，娘亲回去，就休了朱亚文？”。
梅青竹笑得很灿烂，却无比小心谨慎的偷偷观察着朱易的脸色。
沉吟片刻，朱易淡然道：“这，就由娘亲自处吧。娘亲的事情，孩儿怎好置喙？”。
梅青竹沉默了一阵，她才小心的问道：“那，娘亲回去就脱离朱家？以后娘亲还来多看望朱易？”。
朱易缓缓点头，接着便是轻笑道：“娘亲毕竟是孩儿生母，若是有空，自然要常来往才是。但是那沂水朱家的人，没有必要，就不要在孩儿面前出现了。”。
略微顿了顿，朱易洒然道：“外公和几个舅舅，想要来长安，也是好的。”。
梅青竹的笑容又浓了几分，她很清脆的答应了一声。
又盘算了一阵子，朱易才挥手让堂下所有管事都离开了院子。等所有管事都退走了，朱易才肃然道：“等孩儿在长安站稳了脚，就让几个舅舅派人来长安一趟吧。梅家以军伍‘兴家’孩儿想法弄一批长安这边特制的甲胄军械送回去。”。
梅青竹笑得眼睛都眯成了一条线，她亲亲热热的坐在了朱易身边，无比亲昵的抚摸着朱易的脑袋。这辈子，自从朱易出生后，梅青竹就从来没对他这么亲昵过。饶是朱易已经长大成人，依旧被梅青竹的这动作弄得眼角有点发红。
叶重则是在一旁歪了歪嘴。朱易这话要是传了出去，宋国国君怕是第一个要赶来长安和他理论。梅家掌握了宋国几乎一半的军力，朱易还要把大汉朝特制的军械甲胄送去梅家，这是什么意思？
明摆着，朱易这就是告诉梅青竹，如果他的外公和几个舅舅想要造反，那就把宋国的国君一家子都给宰了吧。反正朱易和银川公主、白烁君还有天大的仇怨，这笔账迟算不如早算。
长叹了一口气，朱易最后吩咐道：“娘亲还是赶紧回去，和朱家的关系，能断则断吧。娘亲的封赏，等娘亲断了那边的事情，孩儿再请刘戈公颁布下去就是。”。
一如前面所说，朱易继承左国正之位后，梅青竹作为他生母，也将得到新的封诰，成为大汉朝顶级尖儿的女权贵之一。但是毫无疑问，当梅青竹依旧是朱氏的主母时，朱易是不愿意让她得到新的封号、相应的权利和利益的。
叶重只觉得一阵好笑，可怜朱亚文这样殷勤的派了崩山铁骑一路护送朱易，奈何朱易不领情啊。等梅青竹执意和朱氏断绝一切关系后，沂水朱氏注定要没落。朱氏当年对朱易逼迫太甚，现在怪不得朱易要这样回报他们。
絮絮叨叨的和梅青竹分说了许多，梅青竹终于心满意足的离开了公爵府。
朱易会用最大的力量打击报复沂水朱氏，但是他永远无法和自己的母亲还有母族断绝关系。相反，他还必须用自己最大的力量培植母族的势力，否则他在长安，毕竟是无根之木，缺少帮手的他，又怎能立足得稳？
送走了梅青竹，朱易这才无奈的看向了叶重。
“刚才娘亲的话，你听到了。我现在手上没人。那些管事，虽然是左国正一脉的世仆，但是总要有人帮忙盯着。叶重啊，你说说看，我该怎么做？”
望着叶重，朱易眼里尽是疲累和无奈。他身边的门客也就这么些人，来自苍狼城的那些门客，杀人放火都是一等一的好手，要他们帮忙操持政务、财务，用不了三个月朱易就会彻底倒台破产。
叶重望着朱易，竖起了一根手指：“公子许诺过我，将苍狼城封赏给我。”
朱易望着叶重，深沉的说道：“全力帮我半年，让我在长安站稳脚跟，我就全力帮你得到你想要的那东西！”。
听了听，朱易又急忙说道：“不过就算你得到了你想要的东西，你也不能就这样甩手的！”。
对于叶重的能力，朱易是深以为依仗的，他还真怕叶重就这么一走了之了，不理会他这个老主人。
两人开诚布公的对这个问题商谈了一阵，最终叶重给了朱易一个建议。
朱易的根基太浅，没有可信之人，没有可用之人。但是他在宋国，还是有不少好友知交。朱易的那些好友，在算计朱衍一事中，还给了朱易极大的帮助。他们都是一些宋国世家的庶子或者干脆是私生子，虽然得到了世家子弟应有的教育，也都有一定的能力，但是他们在家族中的地位，却和当年的朱易一样的尴尬。
这些人，就是朱易眼下最好的帮手。
“召集他们来长安吧，让他们帮公子打理各方面的事务，他们也有这样的能力。公子许诺他们，三五年后，等公子培养出了可堪使用的人后，帮他们夺取家族的权力就是了。”
叶重轻笑着给了朱易最终的建议。

Chapter 248: Half-year appointment
After confirming Zhu Yi's identity, he naturally wanted to take over Zuo Guozheng's title and official position. When Liu Ge confirmed Zhu Yi's identity, started handling various files and official documents for Zhu Yi's return, and handed over various seals and tokens, Yan Hui walked away with a stinking look on his face.
After a busy night, all the handover procedures were finally completed. Zhu Yi suddenly transformed into the clan of the Han Dynasty, Zuo Guozheng, Duke of the Han Dynasty. Under the attentive leadership of Liu Ge, all the retainers brought by Zhu Yi settled in Zuo Guozheng Mansion left by Liu Qi. It was an extremely luxurious mansion that ranked among the top 30 in Chang'an, covering an area of ​​1,000 acres.
By the time Zhu Yi sorted out the most important issues at the moment and gathered all the big and small supervisors of Zuo Guozheng Mansion together, it was already noon. The violent storm last night was like a nightmare, leaving no trace. Now the sun was shining brightly, and the blazing sunshine made the hundreds of stewards standing in the courtyard of the Duke's Palace drip with sweat.
Wearing a gauze gown, Zhu Yi sat under the eaves, looking coldly at these respectful-faced stewards.
When the sun was so intense that the stewards almost fainted, Zhu Yicai said lightly: "That's all, from now on, work with peace of mind and work with your heart. Everything will be in accordance with the previous rules. I am not the kind of unkind master. As long as you are diligent, diligent and respectful, I will not select a few unlucky people to kill for others to see."
Ye Chong leaned against a pillar and looked at the stewards with a smile. Zhu Yi allowed them to be burned like this by the sun, which was the right thing to do. If the new master comes to power and doesn't give these people below any pain, maybe there will be a lot of messy things happening.
A little more beating will make it easier for Zhu Yi to truly take over the huge inheritance left by Liu Qi in the future. Not to mention how powerful the official position of Zuo Guozheng is, what is the annual output of the two counties under Liu Qi's name? How many industries in the two counties belong to Zhu Yi? How many people are needed to take care of this?
Judging from the fact that there are more than 400 people in charge of the Duke's residence, you can imagine how big the family business is. Then there was only the sound of ringing, and Mei Qingzhu came over with a few personal maids, followed by the vicious bloody mango, with a smile on his face.
"Zhu Yi, my son, you have just come to Chang'an, and you are not familiar with everything. There is no suitable candidate for the affairs of the Duke's palace. There are many smart and capable people here, mother, who can help you share the burden!" Mei Qingzhu smiled so much that her eyes narrowed into a line. Zhu Yi became the Duke of the Han Dynasty. How much benefit can this bring to her mother's clan?
Ye Chong smiled and looked at Zhu Yi to see how he would answer this sentence.
Let the stewards brought by Mei Qingzhu interfere with the affairs of Zuo Guozheng's house. I'm afraid that after a while, Zhu Yi will have nothing to do, right? On the contrary, although Zhu Yi was not familiar with these stewards of Zuo Guozhengfu, they had been servants of Liu Qi's family for generations, so they were more reliable and trustworthy.
Zhu Yi looked at Mei Qingzhu with a serious face, and after a long time, he sighed quietly.
"I won't bother my mother to worry about these mundane matters. Liu Fu, prepare three million gold worth of property for my wife to send her out of the house. Each of the people my wife brought with me has a little gold and silver. After all, they are here for a trip to Chang'an, so we can't let them run away in vain!"
Among the many stewards in the yard, the white-bearded old man who took the lead among the four old men standing at the front hurriedly stepped forward and responded respectfully.
Mei Qingzhu's face immediately turned livid. She glared at Zhu Yi bitterly and shouted sternly: "Zhu Yi, you!".
Zhu Yi looked at Mei Qingzhu indifferently, and then said softly: "No matter what, you are the mother of the child. Therefore, the child will guarantee the wealth of Dingyuanhou's family. Whatever the Dingyuanhou Mansion wants, just send someone to contact me at any time. However, the Zhu family has nothing to do with the child!".
Mei Qingzhu rolled his eyes, and a smile as bright as a spring flower suddenly appeared on his livid face: "You kid, why are you scaring my mother like this? It has nothing to do with the Zhu family? My mother understands. Otherwise, when my mother goes back, she will divorce Zhu Yawen?".
Mei Qingzhu smiled brightly, but secretly observed Zhu Yi's face with extreme caution.
After pondering for a moment, Zhu Yi said calmly: "Let mother handle this herself. How can a child comment on mother's affairs?"
Mei Qingzhu was silent for a while, and then she asked carefully: "Then, mother will leave the Zhu family when she returns? Will mother come to visit Zhu Yi more in the future?".
Zhu Yi nodded slowly, then chuckled and said: "After all, mother is the biological mother of the child. If she is free, she should visit her frequently. But the people of the Zhu family in Yishui should not appear in front of the child unless necessary."
After a slight pause, Zhu Yi said calmly: "Grandpa and a few uncles want to come to Chang'an, which is also a good thing."
Mei Qingzhu's smile became a little thicker, and she agreed crisply.
After thinking about it for a while, Zhu Yicai waved all the stewards to leave the courtyard. After all the stewards had retreated, Zhu Yicai said solemnly: "When the child has established a foothold in Chang'an, let a few uncles send people to Chang'an. The Mei family used the idea of ​​​​building a family in the army to get a batch of specially-made armors and weapons from Chang'an and send them back."
Mei Qingzhu smiled so hard that her eyes narrowed into a thin line. She sat next to Zhu Yi affectionately and stroked Zhu Yi's head very affectionately. In this life, since Zhu Yi was born, Mei Qingzhu has never been so affectionate to him. Even though Zhu Yi has grown up, the corners of his eyes are still a little red from Mei Qingzhu's actions.
Ye Zhong twisted his mouth at the side. If Zhu Yi's words were spread, the king of Song would probably be the first to come to Chang'an to argue with him. The Mei family controls almost half of the Song Dynasty's military strength, and Zhu Yi also wants to send Han Dynasty's special weapons and armor to the Mei family. What does this mean?
It was obvious that Zhu Yi was telling Mei Qingzhu that if his grandfather and several uncles wanted to rebel, then they should kill the entire Song Dynasty monarch and his family. Anyway, Zhu Yi still has a huge grudge against Princess Yinchuan and Lord Bai Shuo, so it would be better to settle this account sooner rather than later.
With a long sigh, Zhu Yi finally gave instructions: "Mother, it's better to go back as soon as possible. If possible, break off the relationship with the Zhu family. Mother's reward will be announced after mother has settled the matter there. I will ask Liu Gegong to announce it."
As mentioned before, after Zhu Yi inherits Zuo Guozheng's position, Mei Qingzhu, as his biological mother, will also receive a new title and become one of the top female dignitaries in the Han Dynasty. But there is no doubt that when Mei Qingzhu is still the mistress of the Zhu family, Zhu Yi is not willing to let her get a new title, corresponding rights and benefits.
Ye Zhong only felt funny for a while. It was pitiful that Zhu Yawen was so diligent and sent the Mountain Collapsing Cavalry to escort Zhu Yi all the way, but Zhu Yi didn't appreciate it. After Mei Qingzhu insisted on severing all relations with the Zhu family, the Zhu family in Yishui was destined to decline. The Zhu family persecuted Zhu Yi too much back then, no wonder Zhu Yi wants to repay them like this now.
After talking a lot with Mei Qingzhu, Mei Qingzhu finally left the Duke's Mansion with satisfaction.
Zhu Yi will use his greatest strength to retaliate against the Zhu family of Yishui, but he will never be able to sever ties with his mother and mother clan. On the contrary, he must use his greatest strength to cultivate the power of his mother clan. Otherwise, he is a tree without roots in Chang'an. How can he gain a stable footing without helpers?
After sending Mei Qingzhu away, Zhu Yi looked helplessly at Ye Chong.
"You heard what my mother just said. I don't have anyone on hand right now. Although those in charge are servants of Zuo Guozheng's lineage, they still need someone to help keep an eye on them. Ye Chong, tell me, what should I do?"
Looking at Ye Chong, Zhu Yi's eyes were filled with fatigue and helplessness. There are only so many retainers around him. Those retainers from Canglang City are all top-notch masters in killing people and setting fires. If they are asked to help with government affairs and finances, Zhu Yi will completely collapse and go bankrupt in less than three months.
Ye Zhong looked at Zhu Yi and raised a finger: "Young Master promised me to grant me the title of Canglang City."
Zhu Yi looked at Ye Chong and said deeply: "Help me with all your strength for half a year so that I can gain a foothold in Chang'an, and I will do my best to help you get what you want!".
After listening, Zhu Yi hurriedly said: "But even if you get what you want, you can't just throw it away!".
Zhu Yi deeply relied on Ye Zhong's ability. He was really afraid that Ye Zhong would just walk away and ignore his old master.
The two discussed this issue openly and honestly for a while, and finally Ye Zhong gave Zhu Yi a suggestion.
Zhu Yi's foundation is too shallow, and there is no one he can trust or use. But he still had many good friends and acquaintances in Song Dynasty. Zhu Yi's friends also gave Zhu Yi great help in plotting against Zhu Yan. They are all concubines or simply illegitimate children of some aristocratic families in the Song Dynasty. Although they have received the education that children of aristocratic families should have and have certain abilities, their status in the family is as embarrassing as Zhu Yi's back then.
These people are Zhu Yi's best helpers right now.
"Call them to Chang'an and let them help the young master take care of all aspects of affairs. They also have the ability. The young master promises them that in three to five years, when the young master has trained people who can be used, they will help them seize the power of the family."
Ye Zhong chuckled and gave Zhu Yi his final advice.
